seo.title: Calcutta Bamboo Fishing Gaffs – Handmade Custom Gaffs
seo.description: Handmade Calcutta bamboo fishing gaffs, 3–6 ft, with Mustad, 316 stainless or titanium hooks. They float, flex and grip when wet. From $149.99.

descriptionHtml:
Handmade Calcutta bamboo fishing gaffs built one at a time for inshore and offshore fishing. Each gaff is wrapped in one of our signature colorways and set up the way you fish: choose a length from 3 to 6 ft, a Light/Medium, Medium/Heavy or Heavy action, and a ceramic-coated Mustad, 316 stainless steel or titanium gaff hook.

Why fish a Calcutta bamboo gaff?

  • It floats. Drop a bamboo gaff overboard and you get it back.
  • It flexes. The cane bends like a rod and absorbs head shakes, so it's less likely to tear out of a fish.
  • It's light and grippy. It's quick to swing, and the cord wrap holds when your hands are wet.
  • It's easy on your boat. There's no metal shaft to gouge gelcoat.

How to choose your gaff

Length: match it to your freeboard. A 3–4 ft gaff suits kayaks, skiffs and bay boats; 5–6 ft reaches past higher gunwales. Hook gap: 2.50–2.75" for calico bass, halibut, yellowtail and dorado; 3.00–3.25" for tuna, wahoo and white seabass; 4.00" for big tuna, swordfish and marlin. See the full gaff size guide.

FAQ

How much does a bamboo fishing gaff cost?
Our Calcutta gaffs run from $149.99 for a 3 ft gaff up to $299.99 for a 6 ft gaff with a titanium hook. Read what goes into bamboo gaff pricing.

How long does shipping take?
Gaffs are made to order and usually ship in 5–7 business days, or 8–12 business days for custom builds.

Can I get a custom gaff?
Yes. Use the Custom Gaff Builder to pick your own colors, length, action and hook.

How do I care for a bamboo gaff?
Rinse it with fresh water, let it dry and store it out of the sun. More in our care guide.

seo.title: Tuna Spikes – Calcutta Bamboo Ike Jime Brain Spikes
seo.description: Handmade tuna spikes: 316 stainless ike jime brain spikes on Calcutta bamboo handles. 3 sizes, optional screw-on sheath. From $94.99.

descriptionHtml:
Handmade tuna spikes for a fast, clean kill and better-tasting fish. Each one is a 316 stainless steel ike jime brain spike on a Calcutta bamboo handle, wrapped to match our gaffs and deck brushes.

Why spike your tuna?

A quick, accurate spike to the brain stops a fish from thrashing on deck. That means less bruising, less lactic acid build-up and better color, texture and flavor. It's the first step of the Japanese ike jime method, and anglers who spike and bleed their fish can taste the difference. Learn more in what is a tuna spike and when to use it.

Choose your size

  • 1/4" × 4": yellowtail, bonito, dorado and school-size tuna.
  • 5/16" × 4.5": the all-around size for yellowfin and bluefin.
  • 3/8" × 5": larger tuna and other big, thick-skulled fish.

Every spike is available with an optional screw-on sheath to protect the point when it's in your bag or on your belt.

FAQ

What is an ike jime spike?
It's a sharp spike used to quickly pierce a fish's brain, killing it instantly and humanely so the meat stays in the best possible condition.

What's the spike made of?
316 marine-grade stainless steel on a naturally buoyant Calcutta bamboo handle.

Can I get a custom tuna spike?
Yes. Design one in your own colors with the Custom Tuna Spike Builder.

Before you buy, read what to look for in a tuna spike.

seo.title: Boat Deck Brushes – Calcutta Bamboo Handle Boat Brushes
seo.description: Boat deck brushes on handmade Calcutta bamboo handles, 3–5 ft, in colorways that match your gaff. Built for saltwater washdowns. From $149.99.

descriptionHtml:
Boat deck brushes on handmade Calcutta bamboo handles, wrapped in the same colorways as our gaffs and tuna spikes. They're built for the washdown at the end of a long day: blood, scales, bait and dried salt.

Why a Calcutta handle?

  • Light and strong: easy to work with for a full-deck scrub.
  • Naturally buoyant: bamboo floats.
  • Cord-wrapped grip: it stays secure when everything is wet.
  • Matches your gear: pair it with the same colorway as your gaff and spike.

Choose your length

  • 3 ft: compact for smaller boats, cockpits and lockers.
  • 4 ft: the all-around length for most center consoles and sportfishers.
  • 5 ft: extra reach for larger decks, transoms and swim steps.

FAQ

What's the best deck brush for a saltwater boat?
Look for a brush that won't swell, shed or loosen after repeated salt exposure, with enough bite for non-skid. Read the best deck brush for saltwater boats and how to choose a marine deck brush.

Can I get a brush in my own colors?
Yes. Use the Custom Deck Brush Builder.

How long does shipping take?
Brushes are made to order and usually ship in 5–7 business days, or 8–12 for custom builds.

seo.title: Pick Gaffs – Short Calcutta Bamboo Hand Gaffs, 24" & 32"
seo.description: Short, handmade Calcutta bamboo pick gaffs in 24" and 32" lengths for kayaks, skiffs and close work at the rail. Optional butt cap. From $149.99.

descriptionHtml:
Calcutta bamboo pick gaffs are short, handmade hand gaffs for close-quarters work: sticking fish at the rail, landing fish from a kayak or skiff, and handling fish on deck.

  • 24": compact for kayaks, skiffs and tight cockpits.
  • 32": a little more reach for bay boats and center consoles.
  • Calcutta bamboo: light, strong and naturally buoyant.
  • Cord wrap: a sure grip with wet hands. An optional butt cap is available for a finished end.

A pick gaff is easy to stow and quick to swing, and it makes a great partner to a longer traditional Calcutta gaff on bigger boats.

FAQ

Pick gaff or traditional gaff?
If you fish from a kayak, skiff or low-sided boat, a short pick gaff is often all you need. If your gunwales are high or you target big pelagics, add a 4–6 ft gaff. See our gaff size guide.

Can I get one in custom colors?
Yes. Use the Custom Gaff Builder.

descriptionHtml:
Custom bait nets with handmade Calcutta bamboo handles, wrapped in the colors you choose. They're made for scooping anchovies, sardines, mackerel and other live bait out of the tank quickly and gently, so your bait stays lively.

  • Calcutta bamboo handle: light, strong and naturally buoyant.
  • Cord wrap grip: control with wet hands.

FAQ

How do I use a bait net without hurting the bait?
Scoop with the current in the tank, keep the net in the water as long as possible and move quickly. Read how to use a bait net.
